kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
تساهمت (form VI)
# تَسَاهَمْتُ (tasāhamtu) /ta.saː.ham.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَسَاهَمَ (tasāhama)
# تَسَاهَمْتَ (tasāhamta) /ta.saː.ham.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَسَاهَمَ (tasāhama)
# تَسَاهَمْتِ (tasāhamti) /ta.saː.ham.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَسَاهَمَ (tasāhama)
# تَسَاهَمَتْ (tasāhamat) /ta.saː.ha.mat/: third-person fem
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
